name: Drakula's Ascension
detailed_description:
"Drakula's Ascension" is a challenging, yet simple platformer with a retro gothic horror theme where you have to overcome failure in order to ascend back to the surface. All to live a life of your dreams, one that you once lived. Face demons in hell, the caves beneath the surface, the church of your village, the castle that belongs to you, and the ones inside your head telling you to give up. You're immortal, you have no reason to stop going, your only punishment from failing is that you have to take steps that you took before.

Gameplay:

  • Compose yourself for the troubles that await!

    Ascend from the bottom floor and clear the enemies that block your path! Be careful though, as one mistake can turn you into your worst enemy, as you have to rise again.

  • Double jump, duck, and attack at any time!

    An old school platforming feel, where you can truly test the limits of such simple and familiar controls

  • Develop your patience!

    Take your time with each jump and track the enemies' patterns. They may seem overwhelming at first, but each enemy is quite simple to conquer once you've learned how to best them.

- The higher you climb, the more you have to lose

- Progress and loss thereof is auto-saved

- Challenging, simple, and addictive gameplay

- See which of your friends can ascend and conquer their enemies

- Hours of learning to master yourself await you

Supports Mouse, Keyboard, and controller

Starting Tips:

  • Check the control settings to learn the controls or figure out what works best for you

  • You can duck, double jump, and attack during both!

  • You can slice through and destroy projectiles

short_description: Prove your ability to reach your true potential and enjoy retro platforming and combat with a potential cost of starting from the bottom all over again in Drakula's Ascension! Overcome the demons keeping you down, all for your freedom and the view at the top of your castle that once was yours.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains stylized fantasy violence, horror themes, and occasional dark imagery involving undead creatures, demons, and supernatural elements. While there is no graphic gore or sexual content, the tone may not be suitable for all audiences.
